# RavenRS

> An open-source Rust GUI framework: one declarative, reactive UI for Windows, macOS, Linux and WebAssembly, with GPU rendering, semantic design tokens, records, forms and reporting.

Framework version: 27.1.28. License: MIT OR Apache-2.0.

Start with `npx create-ravenrs minha-loja`. For exact APIs, check the project's Cargo.toml and use its version-matched RavenRS MCP server (`cargo ravenrs mcp`).
